## Numbered actions

1. Measure the actual factory-clamp contact footprint and confirm the precut plate covers that load path.
2. Deburr the metal plate and protect the board finish from sharp edges.
3. Position the plate under the rear arm-clamp zone, clear of feet, board anchors, locator bores, and station screws.
4. Install the factory clamp over the reinforced zone and tighten evenly without crushing the board or inducing twist.
5. Recheck local board flatness near the clamp and verify every board foot remains supported.
6. Keep the arm de-energized and do not manually force or back-drive any joint. Use the CAD envelope and static visual checks only at this step. Defer all powered envelope sampling to final commissioning after the E-stop, controller/firmware identity, approved motion limits, and empty-cell program are in place.
7. Install and test the accessible latching power cutoff before powered commissioning.

## STOP

> The clamp illustration is schematic and there is no released plate CAD. Do not fabricate from the picture; use the measured physical clamp footprint and stop if the board bows or any anchor is obstructed.
